item.title: Driver ejected, killed in early morning crash near Lafayette
item.description: One person was killed in a single vehicle crash in Tippecanoe County early Monday morning, and the involvement of alcohol or drugs has not been ruled out.

item.title: US Postal Service to hold job fair in Indianapolis
item.description: The U.S. Postal Service will host a job fair in Indianapolis on Feb. 21 to fill several open positions, with starting salaries ranging from $21.44 to $33 an hour.

item.title: IPS leader looks to expand work-based learning for all Marion County students
item.description: Indianapolis Public Schools is conducting a landscape analysis to assess the demand for a potential area career center and apprenticeship academy. The goal is to expand access for students to career and technical education, early college coursework, and work-based learning opportunities.

item.title: Township Line Road overpass at I-465 to reopen ahead of schedule
item.description: The Township Line Road overpass at Interstate 465 is scheduled to reopen on or after Tuesday, ahead of its original schedule, with lane closures planned for the following weeks to complete final work on the underside of the bridge. The work started in the summer, as shown in the photo in August.

item.title: Pothole season begins in Indiana as snow melt increases
item.description: Snow melt in central Indiana this week will cause potholes to form due to water seeping through cracks in the road, freezing and expanding overnight, and then melting in the afternoon.

item.title: IU installing bronze statue of Bob Knight at Assembly Hall
item.description: IU is installing a permanent bronze statue of legendary basketball coach Bob Knight.

item.title: What Bob Knight told Quinn Buckner following undefeated national title
item.description: The undefeated 1975-76 IU basketball team was honored at halftime of the IU-Oregon game on Monday, celebrating the 50th anniversary of their national championship and the impact it had on the state of Indiana.

item.title: Lamar Wilkerson catches fire as IU takes down Oregon
item.description: IU defeated Oregon 92-74, led by Lamar Wilkerson's 41 points, for their second straight win and fourth in the last five games.

item.title: Indiana lawmakers push first changes following Hailey Buzbee’s death
item.description: Indiana House Speaker Todd Huston announced plans to put new social media rules and expanded AMBER Alert criteria into legislation following the death of a 17-year-old Fishers teenager who had met up with someone she'd encountered on a gaming platform. If approved, social media companies would be required to set up adolescent accounts for anyone under 16, and the state would allow any high-risk missing person younger than 18 eligible for an AMBER Alert.

item.title: Suspect’s cellphone reveals new details in Hailey Buzbee case
item.description: Tyler Thomas is being investigated for the death and disappearance of 17-year-old Hailey Buzbee, after her remains were found in Perry County, Ohio. Evidence from his car and phone suggests he was with her before her death.
